BASE11_agentic_grep_18afd5ad.query_text: Which deposits have more than 50 million in extracted crude total?
BASE11_agentic_grep_18afd5ad.final_sparql:
PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?deposit ?designation (SUM(?crude) AS ?totalExtractedCrude)
WHERE {
  ?output eno:outputForDeposit ?deposit ;
          eno:extractedCrude ?crude .
  ?deposit eno:designation ?designation .
}
GROUP BY ?deposit ?designation
HAVING (SUM(?crude) > 50)
ORDER BY DESC(?totalExtractedCrude)
